title: Polish–Russian War (1654–1667)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Polish–Russian War (1654–1667)", at revision 1374520415, opens: "The Polish–Russian War of 1654–1667 was a major conflict between the Tsardom of Russia and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Between 1655 and 1660, the Swedish invasion was also fought in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and so the period became known as "The Deluge"." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q631991, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1654–1667 major conflict between Tsardom of Russia and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
